description: This file contains unit tests for the GstRialtoDecryptorPrivate class, specifically testing the decryption process in various scenarios including encrypted, clear, and failure cases. It uses Google Test framework and mocks external dependencies such as decryption service and GStreamer buffers.

classes.name: RialtoServerDecryptorPrivateDecryptTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing GstRialtoDecryptorPrivate decryption logic, including setup of mocks and helper methods for different test scenarios.

methods.name: createDecryptorPrivate
methods.description: Initializes the decryptor private object with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: expectGetInfoFromProtectionMeta
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving protection metadata from a buffer.

methods.name: expectWidevineKeySystem
methods.description: Sets expectation for decryption service to identify the key system as Widevine.

methods.name: expectPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Sets expectation for decryption service to identify the key system as PlayReady.

methods.name: expectKeyMappingFailure
methods.description: Sets expectation for failure in mapping the key buffer.

methods.name: expectSuccessfulKeyIdSelection
methods.description: Sets expectations for successful key ID selection process.

methods.name: expectAddGstProtectionMeta
methods.description: Sets expectations for adding protection metadata to a buffer, with optional encryption pattern.
